# DevLingo

DevLingo translates developer documentation directly inside VS Code.

## Installation

Install the extension using:

```bash
npm install
```

Then run `npm run compile`.

Read the [documentation](https://example.com/docs "DevLingo docs").

- Translate Markdown files
- Translate comments
- Preserve code
  - Keep `TranslationProvider` interchangeable

1. Open the project
2. Start VS Code

- [ ] Install dependencies
- [x] Configure DevLingo
